about: Camera of the S3 2052 aerial (aerial2052-1920.jpg): a pinhole camera (position, yaw, pitch, roll, focal; principal point at the frame centre) least-squares fitted to the 50 ring centres measured on the aerial (canon/lines.json centre_world) and their pixels through canon/fit.json Hf1920, on the v4 world's ground (y 70). Minecraft convention: yaw 0 looks +z (south), 90 looks -x; pitch > 0 looks down. Minecraft's FOV setting is vertical: vfov_deg_16x9 for a 16:9 window assumes the 1920x802 frame is the centre band of a 1920x1080 picture.
